cvd.definition: Cumulative sum of signed last-trade volume from the tick tape.
cvd.true_signed_volume: TICK_FLAG_BUY → +qty; TICK_FLAG_SELL → −qty; qty = volume_real if >0 else volume if >0 else unset.
cvd.inferred_last_vs_bbo: If LAST set but no BUY/SELL: last>=ask buy, last<=bid sell, else last vs mid. Labeled inferred, not true.
cvd.quote_only: BID/ASK updates with last==0 and qty unset do not add to true CVD. They update BBO only.
cvd.not: M5/H1 tick_volume, real_volume on bars, VWAP typical*tick_volume, US100 tick_proxy_cvd
